enemies: Temple Guardian (level 30). You cannot use Magic. Rings of recoil will not award the kill.

st.t: Speak to King Roald in Varrock Castle.
s: Yes, I think I've heard of it.

st.t: Go to the temple east of Varrock by the river and tap the large door.
s: Roald sent me to check on Drezel.

st.t: Climb down the trapdoor just north of the temple door. Kill the Temple Guardian (level 30). It is immune to magic so you will need to use either ranged or melee.

e: Temple Guardian (level 30). You cannot use Magic. Rings of recoil will not award the kill.

i: As much essence as you can carry, you'll need to bring 50 UNNOTED in total
Combat gear, ranged or mage to safespot

st.t: Kill a Monk of Zamorak (level 30) for a golden key. You can safespot using the pews.
Talk to Drezel on the top floor of the temple.

i: As much essence as you can carry, you'll need to bring 50 UNNOTED in total

st.t: Go down the ladder and the stairs to the ground floor and leave the temple. Go down the trapdoor just north of it, where you killed the Temple Guardian.
Go to the central room, and study the monuments to find which has a key on it. Use the Golden Key on it.
Use the bucket on the well in the central room.
Go back up to the top floor of the temple.
Talk to Drezel to bless the water.
Use the blessed water on the coffin.

i: As much essence as you can carry, you'll need to bring 50 UNNOTED in total

st.t: Talk to Drezel in the east of the underground temple area.
i: As much essence as you can carry, you'll need to bring 50 UNNOTED in total

st.t: Bring Drezel 50 UNNOTED rune/pure essence in the underground of the Salve Temple to finish the quest!
